updates.title: MAO Announcements and Programs
about.title: A public registry and service gateway for Tubigon agriculture.
about.copy: The Tubigon Agricultural Registry and Services Information System supports the Municipal Agriculture Office in organizing beneficiary records, validating program eligibility, and connecting farmers and fisherfolk to timely advisories, assistance, and insurance coordination.
about.commitments.registry.title: Unified Registry
about.commitments.registry.copy: TARSIS keeps farmer, fisherfolk, and agri-worker information in one municipal record for faster validation.
about.commitments.verified.title: Verified Services
about.commitments.verified.copy: MAO staff can check registration status, assistance history, and digital IDs before releasing program benefits.
about.commitments.visibility.title: Barangay Visibility
about.commitments.visibility.copy: Barangay-level coverage helps the office identify service gaps and prioritize field coordination.
services.title: Quick access to MAO digital services
services.copy: Use TARSIS to register, verify, track, and stay updated on agriculture and fishery services managed by the Municipal Agriculture Office.
services.registration.title: Registration
services.registration.copy: Submit beneficiary information for MAO validation and RSBSA-aligned records.
services.map.title: Barangay Map Locator
services.map.copy: View barangay coverage and locate agricultural service areas in Tubigon.
services.assistance.title: Assistance Status
services.assistance.copy: Check encoded applications, program releases, and beneficiary tracking updates.
services.advisories.title: Announcements
services.advisories.copy: Read current MAO announcements, field alerts, trainings, and program schedules.
services.insurance.title: Insurance / PCIC Info
services.insurance.copy: Coordinate crop and fishery insurance records through verified registry details.
digitalId.title: One QR-coded identity for faster beneficiary verification.
digitalId.copy: TARSIS issues a municipal digital ID that can be scanned by authorized MAO personnel to confirm registry details, reduce duplicate records, and support transparent release of agriculture and fishery services.
digitalId.profile.title: QR-linked profile
digitalId.profile.copy: Scans open the public verification profile maintained by the MAO.
digitalId.records.title: Validated records
digitalId.records.copy: Registry numbers, barangay data, and ownership details stay consistent across services.

announcements.riceSeed.title: Rice Seedling Distribution - 2nd Cropping Season 2026
announcements.riceSeed.excerpt: Qualified RSBSA-registered crop farmers may claim certified rice seeds at their respective barangay halls starting June 20. Bring your MAO Digital ID for verification.
announcements.pcic.title: PCIC Crop and Fishery Insurance Enrollment Now Open
announcements.pcic.excerpt: Registered farmers and fisherfolk in Tubigon are encouraged to enroll in PCIC insurance before the July 31 deadline. Visit the MAO office or apply online.
announcements.tungro.title: Tungro Virus Disease Alert for Southern Barangays
announcements.tungro.excerpt: Rice tungro has been reported in southern barangays. Farmers are urged to plant resistant varieties and report symptoms to their barangay agri-tech staff.
announcements.portal.title: RSBSA Online Registration Portal Launched
announcements.portal.excerpt: Farmers, fisherfolk, and agricultural workers in Tubigon can now complete their RSBSA-aligned registration online through TARSIS.
announcements.training.title: Livelihood Training for Fisherfolk - July 2026
announcements.training.excerpt: The MAO is preparing a two-day livelihood skills training for Tubigon fisherfolk. Registration is free for TARSIS-enrolled beneficiaries.
